newsitem.title: USA: Storm Yates threatens ships in western Pacific.
newsitem.headline: Storm Yates threatens ships in western Pacific.

text.p: Tropical Storm Yates is rapidly intensifying over the western Pacific and may pose a threat to the northern Mariana Islands, private forecaster Weather Services Corp. said.

Yates, with 65 mph winds, is centred near 16N/156E and moving west northwest at 17 mph. Top winds are expected to reach 100 mph or more within 48 hours, when the storm will be nearing the northern Mariana Islands from the east southeast.
Yates will become a major threat to shipping in the region.
